theory.title: Cambios graduales: more and more, less and less y the… the…
theory.explanation: Usa more and more (cada vez más) y less and less (cada vez menos) para describir cambios graduales. La estructura the + comparativo, the + comparativo muestra que dos cambios están relacionados: cuanto más reciclamos, menos residuos producimos.
theory.tip: La estructura the…, the… conecta dos cambios relacionados.

content.passage: Over the last decade, the town has changed considerably. More and more residents cycle to work, and fewer and fewer people drive into the centre. The streets are becoming quieter and cleaner. The council has planted new trees and improved the bus service. The more people use these alternatives, the less traffic the town experiences. Local groups believe that the sooner everyone takes action, the better the results will be.

items.prompt: Describe a change you have noticed in your town.
items.modelAnswer: I think communities can make a real difference when people work together. In my area, there are several ways to improve the environment, such as using public transport, reducing waste and supporting local projects. Although change can take time, small actions often lead to better results. If more people took part, the community would become cleaner and healthier. I hope that by the next few years we will have made further progress.
